newsitem.title: PERU: List of Peru air crash victims from 11 countries.
newsitem.headline: List of Peru air crash victims from 11 countries.

text.p: The Peruvian airline Aeroperu said the 70 victims on its Boeing 757-200, which crashed on Wednesday in the Pacific Ocean, came from 11 countries.

At a news conference, Aeroperu officials listed 30 victims from Chile, 20 from Peru, including the nine-man crew, six from Mexico, four from the United States, two from Italy, two from Great Britain, two from Ecuador, and one each from New Zealand, Spain, Colombia and Venezuela.

Peruvian navy officials have found the wreckage of the aircraft, but said there were no signs of survivors. Peruvian Transport Minister Elsa Carrera de Escalante said a computer failure appeared to have caused the crash.

Among the victims were InterAmerican Development Bank adviser Jose Luis Bobadilla Fernandez, from Mexico; former Peruvian Education Minister Pedro Villena Hidalgo, and the head of the Bogota Electricity Company, Fabio Chaparro.
